convert_box_format: convert bounding boxes from XYWH to XYXY format using BoxMode.convert
compute_box_areas: compute the area of each bounding box in a Boxes tensor using the area method
clip_boxes_to_image: clip bounding box coordinates to stay within image boundaries using the clip method
compute_pairwise_iou: compute intersection over union between all pairs of two box sets using pairwise_iou
compute_pairwise_intersection: compute intersection area between all pairs of two box sets using pairwise_intersection
